stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE283853 is an in-vitro gain-of-function experiment (adenoviral MAFA/MAFB/MAF overexpression vs mCherry in iPSC-derived myotubes). There is no exercise, training, or physical-activity arm, so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified from this series. The paper's exercise-related data (endurance- vs power-trained biopsies) are in GSE200398/dbGaP, not GSE283853.
